San Diego - East Sector (SAN West).description:
East Sector is a combination departure/arrival/enroute sector responsible for: 

a. Arrivals to KMYF, KSEE and KSDM in all configurations; arrivals to KSAN in West Configuration; Departures in East Configuration. 
b. KSEE departures southbound and eastbound; any KSEE departures when traffic volume prohibits KSEE northbound departure. 
c. Enroute traffic over IPL via V66 T326 or V317 
d. Establishing an orderly flow of traffic for Wizky Sector with those aircraft landing KSAN during RWY 09 or RWY 09/27 Configuration.

San Diego - Del Mar Sector (SAN West).description:
Del Mar Sector (position D) is a combination arrival/departure/enroute sector responsible for: 

 a. All arrivals/departures at KCRQ,KOKB,L18 and KNFG. 
 b. All RNM airport departures (Must request release from Miramar Sector). 
 c. Enroute traffic V23, V25, or V27 at or below 6,000' MSL and V186 at or below 7,000' MSL. 
 d. Departures routed from Miramar Sector via V23 at or below 6,000' MSL.

San Diego - SAN 09/27.description:
SAN 09/27 is an Opposite Direction Operation (ODO) Configuration, primarily used when San Diego is under IMC that makes use of the available RWY 27 approaches impossible, but with wind conditions that still favor RWY 27 for departures. During this time, most other Satellite airports remain in their normal configurations. 

During RWY 09/27, the Wizky Sector releases airspace to the North Sector defined as - north of the KSAN ILS 09 final approach course from SARGS direct REDIN at and below 4,000' MSL. 

Under RWY 09/27, use of the rundown list is suspended and tower must obtain verbal release from the Wizky Sector for all RWY 27 departures. (Simulated by the 'Hold for Release' Menu on Vice)
